note: Picks are frozen from the last projection recorded before each game and graded on the selected side. Only hits, misses and pushes count as graded; the hit rate is hits / (hits + misses).

excluded.rule: Player picks whose prediction came from a model version that was not the published one when it was made (shadow versions read by mistake before 2026-11-18). Kept in the ledger with their grade; not counted.
